properties.name: zeta.worker.enabled
properties.description: Master switch to activate Worker mode for cluster-wide hot key detection.

properties.name: zeta.worker.max-tracked-keys
properties.description: Upper bound on distinct keys holding a sliding-window entry; a brand-new key at the cap first reclaims an idle window. A key already holding a HOT seat may exceed the cap when its window is re-created. 0 disables the cap.

properties.name: zeta.worker.epoch-file
properties.description: File used to persist and increment the Worker epoch across restarts. When empty, ${java.io.tmpdir}/zeta-epoch-<workerId> is used, with filesystem-significant characters in the id replaced by '_'.

properties.name: zeta.app-name
properties.description: Logical application name (tenant discriminator) for queue routing. Shared with the App side (zeta.app-name) so report bindings and decision headers always agree.

properties.name: zeta.worker.messaging.report-exchange
properties.description: Direct exchange name for app-to-Worker report messages.

properties.name: zeta.worker.messaging.broadcast-exchange
properties.description: Direct exchange name for Worker-to-app HOT/COOL decisions.

properties.name: zeta.worker.messaging.heartbeat-exchange
properties.description: Topic exchange name for Worker heartbeats.

properties.name: zeta.worker.report-consumer.concurrent-consumers
properties.description: Consumer threads on the report queue.

properties.name: zeta.worker.report-consumer.prefetch-count
properties.description: Unacknowledged messages allowed per report consumer.

properties.name: zeta.worker.report-consumer.staleness-threshold-ms
properties.description: Optional consumer-side staleness filter in milliseconds; 0 disables it and leaves staleness to the queue's x-message-ttl.

properties.name: zeta.worker.report-queue.max-length
properties.description: Maximum messages buffered in the report queue before drop-head applies.

properties.name: zeta.worker.report-queue.message-ttl-ms
properties.description: Per-message TTL inside the report queue.

properties.name: zeta.worker.heartbeat.ping-interval-ms
properties.description: Interval between Worker heartbeats.

properties.name: zeta.worker.heartbeat.ready-grace-ms
properties.description: Grace period before the Worker reports ready with an empty HOT set.

properties.name: zeta.worker.broadcast.hot-queue-capacity
properties.description: Pending HOT decisions before drop-on-saturation. A HOT dropped at saturation, expiry, publish failure or shutdown undoes its promotion and returns the seat.

properties.name: zeta.worker.broadcast.cool-queue-capacity
properties.description: Pending COOL decisions before drop-on-saturation. A burst buffer, not a per-seat guarantee: a dropped COOL converges through the App's hard TTL.

properties.name: zeta.worker.broadcast.cool-burst
properties.description: Most COOL decisions sent in one drain round before yielding to HOT.

properties.name: zeta.worker.broadcast.hot-burst
properties.description: Most HOT decisions sent in one drain round; the floor that keeps COOL from starving HOT.

properties.name: zeta.worker.broadcast.max-decision-age-ms
properties.description: Maximum time a decision may wait in its queue before the drain drops it as expired (1ms-1h). An expired HOT returns its seat. This is a latency bound; a cold accepted record is retained for twice this value and a hot record until a COOL is accepted, never size-evicted.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.enabled
properties.description: When false the listener stays registered but every evaluation is skipped and counted. detection.defaults is not required in this mode.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.window.duration
properties.description: Configured window length. The effective length is alignedSlices * sliceMs, which can be shorter.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.window.slices
properties.description: Slice count; rounded up to a power of two.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.window.retention
properties.description: Idle-window reclamation threshold. Memory only: an idle window sums to zero anyway.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.defaults.hot-qps
properties.description: HOT threshold for keys no rule matches. Required when detection is enabled.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.defaults.cool.strategy
properties.description: COOL_FOR_LOW_QPS or COOL_FOR_EXPIRE. Required when detection is enabled.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.defaults.cool.cool-qps
properties.description: COOL_FOR_LOW_QPS cool-band ceiling; must convert to a coolCount strictly below hotCount.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.defaults.cool.low-qps-for
properties.description: How long the key must stay below cool-qps before it cools; must be at least the window duration.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.defaults.cool.cool-after
properties.description: COOL_FOR_EXPIRE HOT lifetime; at least 1s. Setting it on a LOW_QPS rule is a startup failure.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.rules
properties.description: Ordered rules; each one must be complete (match + hot-qps + cool).

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.rules[].id
properties.description: Stable rule id used in metrics tags; defaults to rule-<index>.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.rules[].match.type
properties.description: exact, prefix or regex. Effective exact rules are indexed by key and checked before the global promotion floor.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.rules[].match.key
properties.description: Exact key, prefix, or regex source (whole-key match).

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.rules[].priority
properties.description: Higher wins; the primary sort key, so a regex rule can outrank an exact one.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.rules[].hot-qps
properties.description: HOT threshold in QPS; converted against the effective window.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.rules[].cool.strategy
properties.description: COOL_FOR_LOW_QPS or COOL_FOR_EXPIRE; required in full, nothing is inherited from defaults.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.rules[].cool.cool-qps
properties.description: COOL_FOR_LOW_QPS cool-band ceiling; must convert to a coolCount strictly below hotCount.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.rules[].cool.low-qps-for
properties.description: How long the key must stay below cool-qps before it cools; must be at least the window duration.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.rules[].cool.cool-after
properties.description: COOL_FOR_EXPIRE HOT lifetime; at least 1s.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.cooling.low-qps-check-interval
properties.description: LOW_QPS re-check period. Between one slice and the configured window duration. Used only when at least one rule selects COOL_FOR_LOW_QPS.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.cooling.sweep-interval
properties.description: Period of the window-reclamation and timer-repair sweep.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.cooling.threads
properties.description: Striped cool-down wheels, one advancing thread each.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.limits.max-active-hot-keys
properties.description: HOT seats; new promotions are refused at the cap and existing keys are never evicted.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.limits.max-hot-broadcasts-per-second
properties.description: HOT send budget enforced on the drain thread.

properties.name: zeta.worker.detection.limits.max-cool-broadcasts-per-second
properties.description: COOL send budget enforced on the drain thread.
